name: vBAT
summary:
vBAT is a 13-minute attention test inside a virtual reality classroom. It tracks head and hand motion tracking; assess active and sustained attention levels; assess impulsivity and hyperactivity behavioral performance. It's designed to assess performance directly related to Focus, Self Control, and Physical Steadiness. 

- In-app purchase of a single-use code for secure redemption)
- Parent/consumer-friendly report with easy online access
- Secure results delivery through a verification-based portal
- Ideal
